description: A session's folder's git: log (the host's own checkout's too, for a changelog), card (sha), diff (sha, path?), page (the Git page's whole read, fetching first and asking gh if asked), pulls (GitHub's pull requests, asked of gh).

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

limit.description: log: how many. page: at least how many commits.

session.description: page: the chat whose transcript says what it touched.

revs.description: page: the branches picked. log: what to read, a ^sha allowed.

follow.description: page: the branches the chat touched.

every.description: page, log: every branch, remote branch and tag.

first_parent.description: log: only the commits made on the branches themselves.

fetch.description: page: git fetch first, GitHub read afresh.

then.description: page: a commit to find, from a link.

repo.description: pulls: owner/name, else the folder's own.

head.description: pulls: a branch whose pull request is wanted.

people.description: pulls: GitHub's pictures of the repository's authors.

github.description: card: GitHub's part only (the author's login, its pull requests).
